_original_lore: Sneaky Creepers are a type of Creeper that
spawns exclusively in the Gunpowder Mines.
They have the appearance of a normal creeper -
however, they are invisible until they approach
name: 潜行苦力怕 (怪物)

source: Sneaky Creepers are a type of Creeper that
spawns exclusively in the Gunpowder Mines.
loreParagraphs.translation: 潜行苦力怕是仅生成于火药矿坑的一种苦力怕.

source: They have the appearance of a normal creeper -
however, they are invisible until they approach
loreParagraphs.translation: 它们外表与普通苦力怕无异——但在接近玩家前处于隐形状态.
